scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:8000/health http-get://localhost:5173 --timeout 60000 && cd electron && npx electron .
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../electron && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
